blocks.byline: Letter from Adina · Founder of Adina Fashion
blocks.note: A note from Adina — the dilemma of every hot morning: comfortable, or put-together?

blocks.headline: How do you stay fresh in the heat without looking sloppy?
blocks.subtitle: Why I looked for a top that is both light and neat, and what I found.

blocks.alt: A woman in her late fifties on a Tel Aviv café terrace, wearing the top in blue

parts.text: For more than 15 years I have run a family boutique in Tel Aviv, with my husband Daniel and our daughter Yael.
And every end of summer I hear at the counter: "I'm hot, but I don't want to look like I left the house in loungewear."
In the Israeli heat, what keeps you cool looks shapeless, and what looks nice feels heavy and clings.
A wide T-shirt is comfortable but looks unfinished. A tailored blouse looks good, until it starts to bother you by noon.
I looked for something in between: light, breathable, with a cut that doesn't cling.
That is how I found Payo. Let me tell you what convinced me.

blocks.title: Six things I love about Payo

items.headline: Because the heat doesn't care what you planned to wear.
items.text: Payo is light and pleasant on the body. On a hot day it doesn't weigh you down, so you can run your errands and still feel fresh.

review.text: I wore it on a hot day and was surprised how light and pleasant it felt. I didn't feel like I was waiting to get home to change my top.

items.headline: Because a long day should end the way it started.
items.text: The fabric breathes, so you're not counting the minutes until you can change. Morning, afternoon and evening, it stays comfortable.

review.text: For me this is exactly a top for a long day. Comfortable in the morning, still pleasant hours later, and still feels neat when I go out afterwards.

items.headline: Because flattering doesn't have to mean tight.
items.text: The cut glides gently over the body. It creates a soft silhouette without clinging anywhere, so you won't spend the day tugging at your top.

review.text: What I love most about Payo is how it falls on the body. It isn't tight where I prefer to blur, but it doesn't feel big and shapeless either.

items.headline: Because getting dressed should take a minute.
items.text: Payo goes with what you already own: jeans, a skirt or shorts. You don't need to build a whole outfit around it.

review.text: It's one of those tops I pull out of the closet when I have no energy to think about what to wear. Jeans, light trousers or something a bit more elegant — it just fits in.

items.headline: Because plans change after five o'clock.
items.text: The same top works for the day and for the evening. With a piece of jewelry or without, and you're ready for dinner.

review.text: I wore it in the morning for errands and kept it on for dinner in the evening. I only changed my trousers and shoes and felt completely put-together.

items.headline: Because every woman has her own colors.
items.text: Payo comes in blue, green, gray and purple. Choose the shade that fits the wardrobe you already love.

review.text: I took the green one because I finally wanted something other than the black I always buy. The colour is lovely and I ended up wearing it much more than I expected.
